newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy Mar 16-30 unleaded reformate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy Mar 16-30 unleaded reformate.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has tendered to buy 250,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded reformate for March 16-30 delivery, a company official said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks offers on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung, Taichung, Kaohisung or Shalung by February 18 and will be valid until February 20.
CPC's last purchase of unleaded reformate was awarded in end-January at $27.60 per barrel c-and-f, its highest award for some years, for delivery March 1-15.
